source.notes: Headless Chrome on a production build of jbrowse-web, with the volvox config loaded, creating the same FeatureTrack snapshots configSchemaCost.test.ts does through the app's own track config union. Each ms is the minimum of fifteen runs after a warm-up, each after a forced GC. Sittings on the shared machine at load 4-9 spread from 62 to 125 ms for the 262 row; the lowest sitting is recorded. MST's type check is off in a production build and on under jest, which config-schema-construction's jsdom row ran with; the two also differ in engine and DOM, and nothing here separates those.
